summary: Five new tests cover the task's required anchors: picker/entry/checkbox render (+ fetch('all') wiring), full submit payload shape, the 'from the start' sentinel -> null mapping, the non-vacuous inactive-target hint, and edit pre-fill. All assert on real emitted payloads / rendered DOM (behaviour, not mock-called). The hint test is correctly non-vacuous (asserts both active+non-active options are present BEFORE choosing the non-active one). storeMock was extended with a reactive funnels ref + fetch, seeded with one active and one non-active funnel in beforeEach. 458/458 vitest green, no unhandled rejections. Two optional coverage gaps noted.

findings.finding: No test asserts the documented edge case that switching the target funnel resets the previously-chosen entry step back to the 'from the start' sentinel (step ids are funnel-local). The watch implements it but it is unverified.
findings.recommendation: Add a test: pick target A, pick entry st1, switch to target B, submit -> targetEntryStepId is null. Optional (the reset is simple), but it is the one behaviour in the SUBSCRIBE branch with no guard.

findings.finding: The edit-pre-fill test asserts the target label and the end-parent checkbox, but not that the pre-filled targetEntryStepId (st2) is retained on submit. The submit path for the edit case is therefore only partially guarded. Low risk since the fresh-pick submit tests cover the emit logic.

tests: vitest 458 passed; 5 new SUBSCRIBE tests green; check-locales.mjs green
